# Streamlabs script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## streamlabs.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Streamlabs right now.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamlabs.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.streamlabs_is_connected()
    ```

## streamlabs.sendTestEvent

Fakes a Streamlabs event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Streamlabs and it works without a connection.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `kind` | Optional. Which event: "donation", "charity", "merch" or "loyalty". Default "donation". |

**Gives back:** true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamlabs.sendTestEvent", new { kind = "donation" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.streamlabs_send_test_event(kind="donation")
    ```
